edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the debited account.
transferFrom enforces the ensure() whitelist before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to condition() when no whitelist bypass matches.
Whitelist comparison against the owner privilege bypasses all sale limits.
Whitelist comparison against tradeAddress bypasses all sale limits.
canSale mapping allows an address to skip condition() checks.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether limits apply.
condition() reads _onSaleNum to cap sales per address.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
transferFrom decrements allowance without SafeMath protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decreased with raw subtraction.
balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] are updated with raw arithmetic.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transfer.
msg.sender determines spender allowance rights and debited-account equality.
delegate() authorises execution from msg.sender against owner.
delegate() performs a delegatecall with caller-supplied target and calldata.
The owner guard is the only barrier before the unrestricted delegatecall.
init() is restricted to the owner.
init() writes the scaled minimum sale amount.
init() writes the scaled maximum sale amount.
init() writes the per-address sale count limit.
init() scales sale limits using decimals.
batchSend() is restricted to the owner.
batchSend() debits balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length without overflow checks.
batchSend() mutates balanceOf without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress() installs an address that bypasses sale restrictions.
setTradeAddress() is restricted to the owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve() uses msg.sender as the owner key of the allowance mapping.
constructor assigns owner and initial supply to msg.sender.
constructor stores msg.sender into owner.
constructor mints the full supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied amount.
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner at deployment.
